m: येन ind. (instr. of 3. य) by whom or by which, by means of which, by which way, RV. &c. &c.
in which direction, whither, where, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
on which account, in consequence of which, wherefore, MBh.; R.; Kathās.
that, so that, in order that (with pres. or fut. or Pot.)
a: येन — ind. (Strictly instr. sing. of यद used adverbially) 1 Whereby, by which, wherefore, on which account, by means of which; किं तद्येन मनो हर्तुमलं स्यातां न शृण्वतां R. 15. 64, 14. 74. --2 So that; दर्शय तं चौरसिंहं येन व्यापादयामि Pt. 4. --3 Since, because.

m: येवाष m. N. of a noxious insect, AV. (cf. यवाष).
येयायेय n. (√ 1. या) that which is to be gone after and not to be gone after, MW.
येयजामह m. N. of the expression ये यजामहे (which immediately precedes the Yājyā or formula of consecration), VS.; ŚrS. &c.
येयज्ञेनेतिसूक्त N. of the hymn, RV. x, 62 (beginning with ये यज्ञेन), Cat.
येष् cl. 1. P. येषति, to boil up, bubble, RV.; AV.; (Ā.) येषते, to exert one's self, endeavour, Dhātup. xvi, 14 (v.l. for √ पेष्).
a: येष् — {vI.v} {c1c} A. (येषते) To try, strive, attempt. {vII.v} {c1c} A. Ved. 1 To bubble. --2 To flow.

m: येष्ठ mfn. (superl. fr. √ 1. या) going best, very swift or rapid, RV.
